position: Ready to authorize infrastructure work, not ready to invite users
headline: Five implementation contracts now agree on the same locked pilot boundary.
copy: The provider packet, environment validator, test session envelope, and queue repository define the smallest implementation path. Real provider credentials, identity, durable storage, security review, rights approval, and founder authorization are still required.

postures.title: Provider contract
postures.copy: Criteria and region questions are explicit; provider remains unselected.

postures.title: Environment contract
postures.copy: Only safe references and zero-write configuration are accepted.

postures.title: Reviewer and queue
postures.copy: Security and persistence semantics are testable but not connected.

postures.title: Activation
postures.copy: No invitation, endpoint, or public launch exists.

flow.title: Authorize
flow.copy: Founder approves the smallest infrastructure slice.

flow.title: Implement
flow.copy: Connect provider, identity, secrets, and durable storage privately.

flow.title: Audit
flow.copy: Repeat security, rights, privacy, and failure-mode checks.

flow.title: Invite
flow.copy: Open a named invitation only after every prerequisite passes.

decisions.label: Implementation packet
decisions.reason: Five contracts now define the same boundaries.

decisions.label: Provider credentials
decisions.reason: No provider account or secret has been connected.

decisions.label: Pilot activation
decisions.reason: Founder authorization and production controls are absent.

locks.title: Deployment lock
locks.copy: No provider endpoint, domain, runtime, or credential has been activated.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: Signed test sessions do not authenticate a real reviewer.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: The queue repository is a reference implementation, not a connected durable store.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: Evidence-ready candidates remain blocked from publication and registry merge.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Readiness evidence cannot activate invitations or a public service.
